title: Core: shape pen tool path builder
description: Implement a pen tool path-building helper in packages/core/src/engine/pentool.ts. This is the state machine for the pen tool: beginPath(), addAnchorPoint(x,y), addCurvePoint(x,y,cx,cy), closePath() -> ShapePath. The output is a ShapePath with proper moveTo/lineTo/curveTo/close commands. Also implement addPointToPath(path, point, isSmooth) for adding bezier curve handles. This is purely data transformation — no UI. Add unit tests.
